_declaration.blind_for: any run logged after 2026-09-09; a hit on run 1 is not a blind finding, since the list was written with run 1's terms_added in view
_declaration.what_it_is: a word list per absent_by_design term, so a term the restater ADDED can be screened against the terms the ontology DECLARED absent. A word list decides word sense here and is stepped around by any paraphrase (nonidentity-census T1-1); each alias carries the basis it was written on. A second table, scope_required, lists added terms that carry NO value until their scope is declared -- boundary, horizon, environment variables, and what is excluded -- so an addition of one on a sheet with no declaration is SCOPE_UNDECLARED, a third state beside reimport and unmatched, not a synonym of any absent term.
